# Next workflow: a targeted edit, not a new build

This is a scoped revision to an existing project, so the right path is **edit → verify → re-render → confirm**. You don't need the full create-from-brief flow.

1. **Find the title.** Locate every place the title appears: the title text element in the composition HTML, any duplicated text such as a lower-third, end card or metadata, and any project or config fields that store it.

5. **Preview.** Look at the frames where the title appears, plus a frame on either side of its entrance and exit.
6. **Render.** Re-render the final output with the existing settings: resolution, fps, codec and duration.
7. **Confirm and hand back.** Report what changed (old title → new title), where it changed, and give the new output for sign-off.
